description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC module. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and references to external dependencies.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModule service, managing IPC client connections.

methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService, given an ICdmService reference.
